rules.R1: every amount is a two-decimal string (e.g. "1234.50"), never a float
rules.R2: by_dept must contain all four departments med/surg/ped/derm (include a department even if count is 0)
rules.R3: by_month keys must be in ascending month order
rules.R4: only status=completed rows count toward counts and revenue; cancelled and no_show do not
